title: Pooled, Growth-Based Assays
author: David Ross
materials: Load the reagents and labware required for the 96-well growth plate prep into automation system or deck of automated liquid handler: The combined cell culture M9 Media Selection Antibiotic stocks, typically at 10x higher concentration than the final concentration to be used in the wells of the growth plates Additional additives needed for the experiment, e.g., inducers for control of selection circuit; ligand stocks for sensor protein assay; inhibitors (i.e., drugs) for protease assay, maintenance antibiotics Growth plates: square-well polystyrene plate with 1.0 mL per well max volume, made by Agilent, part no. 204799-100 (only fill cultures up to 0.5 mL per well).

steps.title: Prepare Initial Cultures
steps.instruction: Start cultures for the calibration variants, normalization variants, and the variant library.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate mixed calibration variants: Add a scraping from the glycerol stock to 5 mL of M9 Media in a 15 mL snap-cap culture tube (or 100 mL M9 in a 250 mL baffled flask depending on the branch).

Inoculate normalization variants: Add a scraping from the glycerol stock for each of the two 'best' normalization (always-on) variants into separate 15 mL snap-cap culture tubes with 5 mL M9 Media each.
Inoculate variant library: Add one aliquot of glycerol stock to 100 mL of M9 media in a 250 mL baffled culture flask.
Incubate all cultures overnight for approximately 18 hours at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm.

steps.title: Combine and Normalize Cultures
steps.instruction: Combine the overnight cultures to create a pooled starting population.

substeps.instruction: In a 250 mL baffled flask, combine: 50 mL M9 Media, 0.5 mL of each normalization variant culture, 1 mL of mixed calibration variant culture (or 49 mL if using the calibration flask), and 48 mL of the variant library culture.
Incubate for 4-5 hours at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm to allow for approximately one doubling.
Measure the OD600 of all cultures.

steps.title: Prepare and Incubate First Growth Plate
steps.instruction: Seed the first growth plate and begin the initial incubation phase.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 450 µL M9 Media into each well of the growth plate, ensuring each condition has 4 replicate wells.
Pipette 50 µL of the combined cell culture into each well.
Apply a gas-permeable seal to the plate.
Incubate for 12 hours at 37°C with the fastest shaking possible (e.g., Biotek Neo2SM: double orbital shaking at 807 cpm and 1 mm diameter).
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Transfer to Second Growth Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the second plate and transfer cells from the first plate.

substeps.instruction: During the first incubation, prepare the second growth plate with 490 µL mixed media per well (M9 Media plus additives such as inducers, ligands, maintenance antibiotics, or inhibitors).
Pre-warm the second growth plate approximately 10 minutes before the end of the 12-hour incubation so the media reaches 37°C exactly when the incubation ends.
Remove the gas-permeable seal from the first plate and transfer 10 µL from each well to the corresponding well in the second plate.
Apply a gas-permeable seal to the second plate.

steps.title: Incubate Second Plate and Prepare Third Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the second plate and prepare the third plate for selection.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the second growth plate for approximately 3 hours with the fastest shaking possible (Biotek Neo2SM: double orbital shaking at 807 cpm, 1 mm diameter).
During this time, prepare the third growth plate with 450 µL mixed media per well (M9 Media, same additives as plate 2, and selection antibiotics at varying concentrations).
Pre-warm the third growth plate approximately 10 minutes before the end of the 3-hour incubation.
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to Third Plate and Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to the third plate and harvest DNA from the second plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gas-permeable seal from the second plate and transfer 50 µL from each well to the corresponding well in the third plate.
Apply a gas-permeable seal to the third plate and place it in the incubator.
Immediately after the third plate is incubated, combine the 4 replicate wells for each condition from the second growth plate into a single well of a polypropylene deep well plate.
Perform plasmid DNA extraction. Elute with nuclease-free water if BarSeq prep is immediate; otherwise, use EB buffer or TE-4 to avoid DNA degradation.

steps.title: Incubate Third Plate and Prepare Fourth Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the third plate and prepare the fourth plate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the third growth plate for approximately 3 hours with the fastest shaking possible.
During incubation, prepare the fourth growth plate with 450 µL of the same mixed media as the third plate (M9, additives, and selection antibiotics at the same concentrations).
Pre-warm the fourth growth plate approximately 10 minutes before the end of the 3-hour incubation.
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to Fourth Plate and Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to the fourth plate and harvest DNA from the third plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gas-permeable seal from the third plate and transfer 50 µL from each well to the corresponding well in the fourth plate.
Apply a gas-permeable seal to the fourth plate and place it in the incubator.
Immediately after the fourth plate is incubated, combine the 4 replicate wells for each condition from the third growth plate into a single well of a polypropylene deep well plate.
Perform plasmid DNA extraction using the elution buffers specified previously (nuclease-free water, EB, or TE-4).

steps.title: Incubate Fourth Plate and Prepare Fifth Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the fourth plate and prepare the final growth plate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the fourth growth plate for approximately 3 hours with the fastest shaking possible.
During incubation, prepare the fifth growth plate with 450 µL of the same mixed media as the fourth plate.
Pre-warm the fifth growth plate approximately 10 minutes before the end of the 3-hour incubation.
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to Fifth Plate and Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to the fifth plate and harvest DNA from the fourth plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gas-permeable seal from the fourth plate and transfer 50 µL from each well to the corresponding well in the fifth plate.
Apply a gas-permeable seal to the fifth plate and place it in the incubator.
Immediately after the fifth plate is incubated, combine the 4 replicate wells for each condition from the fourth growth plate into a single well of a polypropylene deep well plate.
Perform plasmid DNA extraction using the elution buffers specified previously.

steps.title: Final Incubation and DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Complete the final incubation and harvest the remaining DNA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the fifth growth plate for approximately 3 hours with the fastest shaking possible.
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.
Combine the 4 replicate wells for each condition from the fifth growth plate into a single well of a polypropylene deep well plate.
Perform the final plasmid DNA extraction using the elution buffers specified previously.
